result.limits: Threshold application only, using the separate primary coverage/arithmetic review. Does not recompute predictions, metrics or bootstrap intervals. Source/scene intervals do not estimate training-seed uncertainty. Canonical camera-linear scores retain the original target convention. Numerical passes alone cannot authorize full-frame integration, promotion or establish SOTA/100MP10s.

Independent arithmetic and coverage from existing score logs only; metrics/prediction pixels and classical witness definitions are not recomputed. Same specified NumPy PCG64 draws, separately reconstructed and byte-bound; scalar summation and manual quantile replace production vectorized bootstrap. Does not measure training/selection or unknown scene-family uncertainty or promote a model.

Independent ISO100/f5.6 is not exact GT; source aperture/time/motion differ. B4/native512 contexts, not a new full102MP restore.

Parent comparisons jointly change architecture, sensor-valid supervision, optimizer/horizon and corpus history; no isolated directional-architecture claim. Canonical camera-linear negatives/target convention retained. No promotion, extension, new full-frame/export/timing or SOTA claim; remaining color/analytic/highlight manual closure is mandatory.
